content.title: Songs for Easter | 2025 — lead worship well
content.text: 0 Songs for Easter | 2025 Feb 27 Written By Monica Moser Our Songs for Easter list 2025 is here! We’ve gathered a list of new and catalog songs to lead your congregations in this Easter season. These songs embody the journey we take each Holy Week — from Jesus’ humble entrance into Jerusalem, to the cross, to resurrection. This list features songs from Brooke Ligertwood, Phil Wickham, Matt Redman and more.Find all the resources you need for every song on MultiTracks.com!
